FN-U8K3XX-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 95
Committee: State Governmental Affairs Sponsor: Senator April Weaver
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 04/05/2023
Senate Bill 95 as introduced would (1) decrease receipts to the State General Fund by an
estimated $58,000 annually; (2) decrease receipts to license plate issuing officials by an
estimated $1,700 annually; and (3) correspondingly distribute to the Alabama Association of
Ambulance Services and the Alabama EMS Association an estimated $29,500 annually,
respectively, by revising the distribution of proceeds of sales of distinctive motor vehicle license
plates to emergency medical services providers, as provided by this bill.
